ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, hairline borders, icon strokes, link text on light surfaces

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, card surfaces, text on dark photography and dark surfaces

char.$description: Char — Dark surface panels, navigation pill background, elevated dark cards

midnight.$description: Midnight — Deepest surface for dark feature cards and modal backgrounds

iron.$description: Iron — Mid-dark panel surface, secondary dark backgrounds behind photography

slate.$description: Slate — Cool-tinted dark surface, used for subtle contrast against warmer darks

mist.$description: Mist — Light card surfaces, hairline borders on white, image overlay tints

smoke.$description: Smoke — Muted helper text, secondary borders, inactive metadata

pewter.$description: Pewter — Secondary body text, body-emphasis borders

ember.$description: Ember — Link text, brand accent, warm highlight on muted cards — single chromatic accent that warms an otherwise neutral system

pine.$description: Pine — Dark green surface for feature cards and link backgrounds on light

tide.$description: Tide — Deep teal-dark surface for link and card backgrounds, complements Pine in the cool brand register

driftwood.$description: Driftwood — Decorative stroke and fill for illustrations and icon-line work, soft cool gray with depth

cedar.$description: Cedar — Warm brown card surface, earth-toned card variant

coral.$description: Coral — Warm-pink card surface, used as an occasional warm-tinted card variant

primary-action-fill.$description: Primary Action Fill — Neutral button treatment for secondary actions and selected controls. Use as the primary filled action background

proxima-nova.$description: Primary typeface across all UI. Weight 300 carries the brand wordmark at 168px and large section headings (62–80px) — the whisper-weight at display sizes is anti-convention, creating authority through restraint instead of shouting with bold. Weight 400–500 handles body, labels, and UI. Weight 600 appears only for emphasis labels. Sizes range from 8px micro-labels to 168px display, a 21:1 ratio that produces a museum-label-to-billboard scale.

lora.$description: Serif accent for body passages and editorial copy. Used sparingly to break the all-sans rhythm — a single serif paragraph next to Proxima Nova body creates an editorial-press feel. Letter-spacing 0.0110em gives it slight breathing room.
